title: Rabbi Dosa (a Palestinian Amora of the Third and Fourth Generations)
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Avodah Zarah, end of chapter 2: “Ulla Shakhfa recited a baraita before Rabbi Dosa — he said to him: Retract — Rabbi Ze’ira said to him: Do not retract.”

He is likewise mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3, saying that what Rabbi commanded — “My widow shall not move from my house” — was so that they would not say to her, “It is the house of the patriarchate, assigned to the patriarchate.” In Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 9:10, concerning when one transgresses “On his day you shall give him his wage.”
In Ruth Rabbah 1:4, Rabbi Huna in his name. In Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 16: “Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Dosa said: Canaan is Eliezer”; Hyman proposes “Rabbi Yose in the name of Rabbi Dosa.”

In Bereshit Rabbah 12:6, Rabbi Berekhyah in the name of Rabbi Dosa gave the reason of Rabbi Abbahu. In the Jerusalem Talmud, end of Moed Katan, [it says] that he died on Rosh Chodesh Nisan. See also the entry Rabbi Drosa.

notes.text: Saved Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah2:9 has תני עולא שכפא קומי רבי דוסא: Ulla Shakhfa recited before Dosa. Shakhfa is retained as his accompanying name/epithet, not invented teaching content. Ketubot12:3 and Bava Metzia9:10 are Jerusalem Talmud; the Dosa name correction remains Hyman’s.

נשוותא in this compressed Ketubot quotation concerns the patriarchate, not women. The saved Guggenheimer English Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot12:3 says that the house belongs to and must serve the patriarchate; the matching Kilayim9:3 Hebrew explicitly has נשיותה. This corrects the earlier local rendering while preserving all earlier versions and the other substantive notes.
